title: SIEM Log Correlation
story: Students use SIEM tools to correlate logs from multiple systems and identify an attack chain.

tasks.title: Search Logs
tasks.description: Search SIEM logs for events related to the suspected attack.
tasks.hint: Start with authentication, firewall, endpoint, and DNS logs.

tasks.title: Correlate Alerts
tasks.description: Link related alerts across multiple systems.
tasks.hint: Correlate by IP, username, hostname, and timestamp.

tasks.title: Identify IOC
tasks.description: Extract a clear indicator of compromise from the correlated data.
tasks.hint: Look for malicious IPs, domains, hashes, or account names.

tasks.title: Trace Attack Timeline
tasks.description: Build the attack sequence from first contact to impact.

tasks.title: Generate Incident Report
tasks.description: Summarize the attack chain, evidence, and recommended response.
tasks.hint: Include scope, IOCs, timeline, and containment steps.
